nodes.name: probe CLI
nodes.description: Drive a real lock from the terminal, through the same Gate the web app uses.

nodes.name: KAGI server
nodes.description: Serves the door page, sign-in and the unlock API. One instance, no database.

nodes.name: clerkAuthenticator()
nodes.description: Authenticates with Clerk's session cookie.

nodes.name: jwtBearerAuthenticator()
nodes.description: Authenticates API calls from other apps by an `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` header, verified against the issuer's public keys.

nodes.name: oidcAuthenticator()
nodes.description: Sign-in with any OpenID Connect provider (authorization code + PKCE).

nodes.name: stdoutAuditSink()
nodes.description: One JSON object per line on stdout; picked up as-is by Cloud Logging, Fly, Vercel, etc.

nodes.name: allOf()
nodes.description: Allow only when every authorizer allows.

nodes.name: claimAllowList()
nodes.description: Allow when the claim at `path` (dot-separated, e.g.

nodes.name: httpAuthorizer()
nodes.description: Delegate to an external HTTP endpoint (e.g.

nodes.name: createGate()
nodes.description: Builds the orchestrator.

nodes.name: GET /d/:doorId
nodes.description: sign in if needed, then show the Unlock button (never unlocks)

nodes.name: POST /d/:doorId/unlock
nodes.description: same-origin only; unlock and show the result

nodes.name: * /auth/*
nodes.description: owned by the authenticator (OIDC callback, logout)

nodes.name: POST /api/doors/:doorId/unlock
nodes.description: JSON, for other apps; only when `api` is set

nodes.name: loadConfig()
nodes.description: Everything comes from the environment (on Cloud Run: plain env vars + Secret Manager).

nodes.name: Clerk
nodes.description: Optional identity provider used through its SDK.

nodes.name: OpenID Connect provider
nodes.description: Signs people in and issues ID tokens (e.g. Pocket ID). Also the issuer of bearer JWTs for the API.

nodes.name: anyOf()
nodes.description: Allow when any authorizer allows.

nodes.name: timeWindow()
nodes.description: Allow only within weekly windows, evaluated in the given IANA time zone.

nodes.name: KAGI
nodes.description: Unlocks a door after a tap on an NFC tag, a sign-in and one button press.

nodes.name: Person at the door
nodes.description: Taps the NFC tag with a phone, signs in, presses Unlock.

nodes.name: Administrator
nodes.description: Puts people in door groups at the identity provider; configures KAGI.

nodes.name: Other apps
nodes.description: Unlock on a signed-in user's behalf with a bearer JWT.

nodes.name: Smart locks
nodes.description: The physical locks, reached only through their vendor's cloud and hub.
